Both RDKit and xTB are available. Now I'll build the molecule. My interpretation of the 2D drawing:

- **Hf** center: bonded to upper phenoxide O, lower bridging oxo O (to Al), two tertiary amine N donors (dashed wedges), and two μ-methyl groups (bold wedges) bridging to Al
- **Al** center: bonded to the oxo O, two μ-methyls, a terminal Me, and an aryl carbon of the bottom-left phenyl
- **Ligand framework**: top-right phenoxide ring bearing N-carbazolyl + CH2–N(Me) arms; the two amines linked by a –CH2CH2– bridge; left amine tethered to the bottom-left phenyl which bears Me, Al, and N-carbazolyl substituents

from rdkit.Chem import AllChem

# 28 N carb_top ; 29-40 carb_top carbons (29,35 junctions CC; 30,36 junctions CN)
# 41 N carb_bot ; 42-53 carb_bot carbons (42,48 junctions CC; 43,49 junctions CN)
elems = ['Hf','Al','O','O','N','N','C','C','C','C','C','C','C','C','C','C',
         'C','C','C','C','C','C','C','C','C','C','C','C','N','C','C','C','C','C','C','C','C','C','C','C',
         'N','C','C','C','C','C','C','C','C','C','C','C','C']

 (0,2,SINGLE),(0,3,SINGLE),(0,4,SINGLE),(0,5,SINGLE),(0,6,SINGLE),(0,7,SINGLE),
 (1,3,SINGLE),(1,6,SINGLE),(1,7,SINGLE),(1,8,SINGLE),(1,23,SINGLE),

 # top phenyl

 # bottom phenyl
 (22,23,AROM),(23,24,AROM),(24,25,AROM),(25,26,AROM),(26,27,AROM),(27,22,AROM),
 # carbazole top
 (28,17,SINGLE),(28,30,AROM),(28,36,AROM),(29,35,AROM),
 (29,30,AROM),(30,31,AROM),(31,32,AROM),(32,33,AROM),(33,34,AROM),(34,29,AROM),
